title: Scattering of Null strings - Flipped Vacuum & CHY
summary: We investigate the scattering of null tensionless strings. Classical null strings, given by the ILST action, give rise to three distinct quantum theories built on different vacua and representations of the underlying 2d Conformal Carroll algebra (CCA) which form the residual gauge symmetries on the null worldsheet. In this paper, we are interested in the quantum theory built out of the so-called "flipped" vacuum which realises the highest weight representation of the 2d CCA.
